scope_issue: Claim generalises from a single product page check by one user to 'no reviews anywhere online'; the source covers only the product page, on one date.
reasoning: The source reports a single observation that no customer reviews appeared on the product page. It does not cover other retailers, forums or review sites, so the universal claim 'anywhere online' is not supported. The source also does not contradict it, it just does not reach that far.
